summary_1line: Krishna defends Arjuna’s abduction of Subhadra, reconciliation follows, their marriage is celebrated, and their son Abhimanyu is born and grows into a promising warrior.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands calmly in the assembly of angry Yadava warriors, persuading them that Arjuna’s abduction of Subhadra is honorable.
Subhadra in simple cowherd dress bows before Draupadi and Kunti in the palace, humbly declaring herself Draupadi’s maid.
The infant Abhimanyu is presented in the royal court as Krishna and the Pandavas look on with joy and priests perform birth rites.
